reference_basis.instruction: Preserve visible face, freckles, pale cool eye appearance, and long wavy dark-blonde/light-brown hair. The coat and selfie crop do not verify full-body proportions; exclude hiking gear, mountain setting, selfie pose, wind, and cold-weather flush.

face_geometry.description: Balanced medium-length oval face with softly defined cheekbones, moderate cheek width, a smooth gently narrowing jaw, and rounded chin. Neither notably round nor angular.

eyes.description: Pale blue-grey to blue-green softly almond eyes, average-to-slightly-wide spacing, visible upper-lid crease, and gently lifted outer corners. Preserve their light cool appearance; exact hue varies with daylight.

brows.description: Medium-full ash-brown brows, naturally straight at the inner half with a low soft arch and fine untidy texture.

nose.description: Straight medium-length nose with a slim-to-medium bridge, softly rounded tip, and balanced nostril width; neither button-small nor strongly prominent.

mouth.description: Medium-wide mouth with softly full natural lips, subtle cupid's bow, and a slightly fuller lower lip. Resting corners have a gentle upward tendency.

skin.description: Warm light-to-medium skin with subtle freckles across nose and upper cheeks, natural outdoor colour variation, visible texture, and a healthy non-glossy finish.

hair.description: Long dark-blonde to light-brown hair with dimensional ash and warm strands, abundant natural loose wave, medium-thick density, and irregular face-framing layers. Styling is mutable.

body_proportions.description: Canonical baseline is lean swimmer-athletic with defined shoulders and strong legs. The selfie and coat obscure most of the body, so full proportions are not independently verified.

identity_relationships.feature_balance: no single feature dominates; eye colour, balanced oval geometry, and wavy dimensional hair identify her together
